results.title: Super admin creates a tenant admin (Platform UI) → activation link → company role → the new admin opens the Admin portal
results.reason: a tenant admin can be made only for a tenant that already has workspaces (DEFAULT here): a NEW tenant's workspace cannot be created or listed by tenant (POST /admin/workspaces takes no tenant, /admin/workspaces rows carry no tenantId) — H-C1-14

checks.name: the SYSTEM_ADMIN logs in through the Platform portal
the dialog is the new 'Tạo tài khoản': four sections, no NOT_READY notice, no SYSTEM_ADMIN type
POST /admin/users → 201 with exactly {username, displayName, email, workspaceId, role}: no tenant id, no password
the activation link is shown once in the dialog (one-time, /auth/activate#token), the platform never shows a password
the summary: account, status Chờ kích hoạt, workspace, role, and the company role as a NEXT step (not done)
[api] the account exists, is pending (not activated) and is WORKSPACE_ADMIN of the chosen workspace
[api] a second account with the same username is refused (409 USERNAME_TAKEN)
the new admin activates through the REAL activation page (set password)
the company role is assigned AFTER activation in the tenant page: the server lists the account as TENANT_ADMIN
the new tenant admin logs in through the ADMIN portal and is not refused
…and sees Công ty của tôi and Người dùng, not the system-wide sections
no unexpected 4xx/5xx from the portal's calls
no unhandled page errors

results.title: Tenant admin: Admin portal → Người dùng → create account (NOT_READY until C1's contract: disabled, reason shown, nothing sent); add-existing is not offered without MEMBER_MANAGE
results.reason: tenant-scoped account creation has no backend route yet (createTenantUser NOT_READY). When C1 delivers it: flip CAPABILITIES.createTenantUser, then this flow creates the account in the UI, activates it through the link, and USER01 continues with it.

checks.name: navigation has Người dùng and Công ty của tôi for a tenant admin
the screen shows the tenant from the SESSION (read-only), never an editable tenant id
create is NOT_READY: the button is disabled, the reason is shown ('Backend provisioning chưa sẵn sàng'), nothing is sent
a forced click opens no dialog and POSTs nothing
[api] the platform route is NOT a workaround: a tenant admin gets 403 ADMIN_REQUIRED from POST /admin/users
add-existing is not offered to a tenant admin who holds no MEMBER_MANAGE (the reason is shown)
no unhandled page errors
